entities.summary: Incheon National University, previously also known as University of Incheon (UI), is a national university in Incheon, South Korea. It's is located in Songdo International Business District in Incheon Free Economic Zone (IFEZ). The university operates the main campus Songdo, and sattilite campuses in Michuhol and Dohwa-dong.
